verdicts_or_reports.element: Header subtitle showing the number of cards
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With Spanish selected and four matching rows visible, the header subtitle should say “4 cards shown.”
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After navigating from Card browser to Settings and back, the four Spanish rows remain visible but the header shows only “Spanish”; the card count subtitle is absent.
steps: Open Card browser from the navigation drawer and select Spanish; verify the header says “Spanish” and “4 cards shown.”
Open Settings from the navigation drawer.
Observe that all four Spanish rows remain visible while the header shows only “Spanish” with no card count subtitle.
Repeat the Settings navigation; the subtitle remains absent.

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.
